The optimized inventory policy recommends a safety stock of 22,105 units (vs SAP: 0), an order quantity of 271,640 units (vs SAP MOQ: 100,349), and a reorder point of 40,172 units. This optimization achieves a 95.0% service level while reducing total annual costs by $554.98 (29.7% savings) compared to the current SAP policy. The recommended safety lead time is 1.87 days (current: 5.00 days), with transport identified as the dominant variability factor.
